titleZh: 单元复习:和顾问谈学习计划
goalZh: 综合运用本单元的说法,讲清自己这学期的课程、打工和困难
canDoZh: 能和顾问谈自己这学期的课程、打工时间和学习上的困难,听懂相关规定

newItems.noteZh: a three-credit class 一门三学分的课;复数 credits 的词尾 ts 读 /ts/,像"次"的声母。
at least twelve credits 至少 12 个学分;least 是长音 /iː/,词尾 st 收住。
twenty hours a week at most 每周最多 20 小时;和 at least(至少)是一对。

newItems.zh: 你做得很好;你表现很棒
newItems.noteZh: 鼓励对方正在做的事做得好(学习、工作、适应新环境),回应说 Thanks!。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: Hi, Lei. Come in! How's your semester?
lines.zh: (国际学生每学期要和顾问见一次面)磊,你好。进来吧!这学期怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Good, thanks! I'm really busy these days.
lines.zh: 挺好的,谢谢!最近特别忙。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: How many classes are you taking?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Five: calculus, physics, programming, Writing 2, and music history.
lines.zh: 五门:微积分、物理、编程、写作 2,还有音乐史。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: Good. International students usually need at least twelve credits.
lines.zh: 很好。国际学生一般至少要修 12 个学分。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: And are you working this semester?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, at the cafe. I go to work on Mondays and Wednesdays.
lines.zh: 在打工,在咖啡馆。我每周一、周三去上班。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Eight hours. Two to six, two days a week.
lines.zh: 八个小时。两点到六点,一周两天。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: That's fine. Students can usually work twenty hours a week.
lines.zh: 没问题。学生一般每周可以打工 20 个小时。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Twenty hours at most? OK, no problem.
lines.zh: 最多 20 个小时?好的,没问题。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: How are your classes? Any problems?
lines.zh: 课上得怎么样?有什么困难吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Writing is a little hard, but I go to the Writing Center.
lines.zh: 写作课有点难,不过我常去写作中心。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And I have a study group for calculus.
lines.zh: 微积分我还有个学习小组。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: Good job! You're doing great, Lei.
lines.zh: 做得好!磊,你表现得很棒。

lines.speaker: advisor
lines.text: The midterms are in Week 8. Good luck!
lines.zh: 期中考试在第 8 周。祝你好运!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Thank you! I'm going to study every day.
lines.zh: 谢谢!我打算每天都学习。

questions.prompt: 磊这学期上几门课、一共多少学分?
questions.explainZh: Five: calculus, physics, programming, Writing 2, and music history. That's sixteen credits.——五门课,16 个学分。

questions.prompt: 顾问说,国际学生一般至少要修多少学分?
questions.explainZh: International students usually need at least twelve credits.——at least 是"至少";20 是每周最多打工的小时数(Twenty hours at most)。
Eight hours. Two to six, two days a week.——每次四个小时,一周两天,一共八个小时。

questions.prompt: 磊觉得哪门课有点难?他是怎么做的?
questions.explainZh: Writing is a little hard, but I go to the Writing Center.——写作课有点难,他去写作中心;微积分他有学习小组。

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:说这学期的课程和安排
grammar.bodyZh:
这个单元说新学期的几种说法:① 这学期上的课用 take:How many classes are you taking? —— Five.;② 这段时间的安排用现在进行时(I'm working on Mondays this semester. / I'm really busy these days.),规定和习惯用一般现在时(Students usually need at least twelve credits. / I go to the Writing Center every week.);③ 不加冠词的说法:go to class、go to work、at home、at school;④ 作业和考试:The essay is due on Friday. / The midterms are in Week 8.;⑤ 数量的下限和上限:at least(至少)、at most(最多)——at least twelve credits / twenty hours a week, at most。
发音:credits 词尾的 ts 合成一个音,像"次"的声母,不要读成 "credit-s";semester、today 里不重读的音节读弱元音 /ə/,轻轻带过。

examples.text: How many classes are you taking? — Five.
examples.zh: 你这学期上几门课?——五门。

examples.text: International students usually need at least twelve credits.
examples.zh: 国际学生一般至少要修 12 个学分。

examples.text: Students can usually work twenty hours a week, at most.
examples.zh: 学生一般每周最多可以打工 20 个小时。
